title: CodeViz Blueprint
description: A rigid description of a codebase's architecture, rendered by template/index.html as an animated isometric engineering drawing. This file is the ONLY artifact an LLM authors; the renderer is fixed.

repo.description: Repository name as it appears on disk, e.g. "metalcraft-agent".

branch.description: Branch or variant label shown next to the repo name, e.g. "rust-rewrite".

title.description: The human name for what this system IS, not what the repo is called. e.g. "The Evolution Harness".

tagline.description: One lowercase sentence under the title describing what the system does. No marketing.

generated.description: Free-form date/commit string shown in the footer.

stats.description: The strip across the top. Facts a reader could not guess. Prefer counts that reveal shape over trivia like file counts.

groups.description: Sidebar section headers. Every node belongs to exactly one. Order them so the reader walks the system in the order it actually runs.

note.description: Optional one-liner shown under the header in the sidebar.

edges.description: Real, concrete connections. Every edge must name what actually crosses it.

glossary.description: Terms a reader may not know. Rendered as a dotted-underline term in the panel; hovering shows the definition.

slug.description: lower_snake_case identifier, 2-48 chars, starts with a letter.

gridPos.description: [column, row] on the isometric grid. Integers, may be negative. Omit to let the auto-layout place the node.

label.description: Displayed uppercase by the renderer. Write it in normal case; 1-3 words.

kind.description: Drives geometry and hatching. See PROTOCOL.md for the shape table. Never invent a kind.

weight.description: Relative visual mass. Use it to say 'this is the big one'. Purely cosmetic.

summary.description: One clause, shown in the sidebar and as the hover card's first line.

detail.description: 2-4 plain sentences in the hover card: what it does, how, and one thing a reader would not have guessed.

paths.description: Repo-relative paths that actually exist. Directories are fine and often better.

status.description: dormant renders faded with a dashed outline; planned renders as a ghost with no fill.

kind.description: Drives line style and packet shape. See PROTOCOL.md.

label.description: What travels, in 1-4 lowercase words. e.g. "chosen parent".

payload.description: The CONCRETE thing: a type signature, a function name, an SQL table, an HTTP route, a channel type. If you cannot name one, the edge is not real - delete it.

detail.description: 2-3 sentences in the connector hover card: when it fires, what it carries, what happens if it fails.

volume.description: How busy this path is relative to the others. Drives packet count and speed.

waypoints.description: Optional manual routing points. Omit unless a line is genuinely tangled.

type.description: h = section heading, p = paragraph, note = indented aside, code = monospace block, rule = horizontal divider (text ignored).

text.description: Plain text. Two inline markups are allowed and nothing else: [[shown text|node_id]] links a phrase to a node (hovering either one highlights the other), and {{term}} marks a glossary term.
